newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB acquires U.K's GEC Meters.
newsitem.headline: ABB acquires U.K's GEC Meters.

text.p: Swiss-Swedish electrical engineering company ABB said it had acquired GEC Meters, Britain's largest manufacturer of electricity meters, from General Electric Co.
It gave no purchase price for the company, which has annual revenues of $48 million and employs around 700.

GEC Meters, based in Stone, north of Birmingham, designs and makes meters for the British, European and other international markets, ABB said in a statement. Its line of meters complements ABB's Alpha electronic metering technology.

"The acquisition forms part of ABB's global strategy to supply complete solutions across the full scope of residential and industrial metering applications and will establish ABB as one of the world's top three suppliers in this field with a network of manufacturing and sales operations worldwide," it said. The unit will be renamed ABB Metering Systems Ltd.
